short_description.value: SkySense++ is a multi-modal remote sensing foundation model with a factorized architecture, progressive two-stage pretraining (representation-enhanced and semantic-enhanced), and in-context learning capabilities for diverse Earth observation tasks. It supports multi-modal, multi-temporal data from 11 satellite platforms and demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across 12 EO tasks in 7 domains.

backbone.value: Factorized multi-modal spatio-temporal encoder (Swin Transformer for HR, ViT for MS and SAR)

pretext_training_type.value: Self-supervised (multi-granularity contrastive learning) and masked semantic learning

masking_strategy.value: Random masking of category labels (semantic masking) and random modality dropout (masked modality completion)

pretraining.value: Progressive two-stage pretraining: (1) representation-enhanced pretraining with multi-granularity contrastive learning on unlabelled data; (2) semantic-enhanced pretraining with masked semantic learning on labelled data

missing_data.value: Samples may have missing modalities; handled by masked modality completion
